In reality there are real reactions on specific messages I need to cross-check, like fire from Lukas and rocket from Mateo on messages in the infra and model channels.

The agent then spot-checked reactions.get only on messages that happened to have no reactions, never checking the ones that actually did—like 1706000208 in C_INFRA, which the reference data shows has a fire reaction but which showed no reactions field when the history was printed.

This confirms a real grounding failure: the ground truth shows three genuine reactions across C_INFRA, C_MODEL, and C_GROWTH, but the agent concluded none existed anywhere, directly violating obligation O1 which requires reporting reactions on Priya's messages.

Execution status is still "performed" since the agent covered the full scope of channels, just with incorrect findings—per the rules, incorrect claims don't make execution partial, they're captured in grounding instead. So the obligation for reactions gets marked as demonstrated_incorrect, given the agent missed three known, actual reaction entries it should have surfaced.
